origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ordinal))
ctrl <- clmm2.control()
c(match(ctrl$method, c("ucminf", "nlminb", "model.frame")),
  ctrl$ctrl$trace, ctrl$ctrl$maxIter, ctrl$ctrl$gradTol, ctrl$ctrl$maxLineIter,
  match(ctrl$ctrl$innerCtrl, c("warnOnly", "noWarn", "giveError")),
  ctrl$optCtrl$trace, ctrl$optCtrl$grtol,
  match(ctrl$optCtrl$grad, c("central", "forward")))

translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from ordinal import clmm2_control

c = clmm2_control()
print(np.array([
    ["ucminf", "nlminb", "model.frame"].index(c["method"]) + 1,
    c["ctrl"]["trace"], c["ctrl"]["maxIter"], c["ctrl"]["gradTol"], c["ctrl"]["maxLineIter"],
    ["warnOnly", "noWarn", "giveError"].index(c["ctrl"]["innerCtrl"]) + 1,
    c["optCtrl"]["trace"], c["optCtrl"]["grtol"],
    ["central", "forward"].index(c["optCtrl"]["grad"]) + 1,
], dtype=float))
